chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"When you enter the graveyard, say: Peace be upon the people of Paradise."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What should be said when entering a graveyard according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches a remembrance to say upon entering the graveyard. The wording conveys a greeting of peace to its inhabitants and reflects remembrance of the hereafter and proper etiquette when visiting graves.
